title: Roof Replacement in Milwaukie, OR
summary: In June 2025, French Roofing replaced a worn shingle roof on a home in Milwaukie, OR. The crew tore off the old shingles down to the deck, added self-adhesive underlayment along the eaves and valleys, new metal valley flashing, and installed dark CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles with new ridge cap.
scope: Tore off the old shingles down to the roof deck
Self-adhesive underlayment along the eaves and valleys, with synthetic underlayment over the rest of the deck
New metal valley flashing where roof sections meet
Installed new CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles and ridge cap
New flashing boots around the plumbing vent pipes
Added the CertainTeed 4 Star warranty upgrade
body: Before the work started, the old shingles were worn and faded, leaves and needles had piled up in a valley, and the metal flashing around a vent pipe had rusted. The photos below go from the finished roof back to what the crew found.

faqs.question: What went under the new shingles on this Milwaukie roof?
faqs.answer: Self-adhesive underlayment along the eaves and valleys, synthetic underlayment over the rest of the deck, and new metal flashing in the valleys.
